section: Perspectives in Education · Ch19 — NEP 2020: 5+3+3+4 Stages (Complete)
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: The Foundational Stage under NEP 2020 covers which age range?
explanation: The Foundational Stage spans ages 3-8 (three years of pre-primary plus Classes 1-2), emphasising play- and activity-based learning.

section: Perspectives in Education · Ch19 — NEP 2020: 5+3+3+4 Stages (Complete)
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: Under NEP 2020's 5+3+3+4 structure, the 'Preparatory Stage' corresponds to which classes, and builds on the play-based Foundational Stage by introducing more formal but still activity-based classroom learning?
explanation: The Preparatory Stage (Classes 3-5) follows the Foundational Stage, introducing subject teachers and formal reading/writing/numeracy while still using activity-based methods.

section: Perspectives in Education · Ch19 — NEP 2020: 5+3+3+4 Stages (Complete)
subject: Perspectives in Education
stem: Under NEP 2020's 5+3+3+4 structure, the 'Middle Stage', which introduces more abstract concepts across Science, Mathematics, Social Science, Arts and Humanities taught by subject-specialist teachers, corresponds to which classes?
explanation: The Middle Stage (Classes 6-8) shifts to subject-specific teaching of more abstract concepts, still linked to experiential learning.
